value.answer: Looks like a dry day in Toronto. The 11am Environment Canada forecast has Monday mainly cloudy with no rain in the daytime, and the evening is only about a 20% chance around 6-7pm. The showers hold off until tonight, starting before morning, with a chance of a thunderstorm mixed in.
